response: Yes, emergency ultrasound fellowship programs can significantly impact emergency medicine residents' ultrasound education. These fellowship programs provide specialized training and expertise in ultrasound, which can then be passed on to residents through teaching, mentoring, and curriculum development. As a result, emergency medicine residents in programs with ultrasound fellowships tend to receive more comprehensive and high-quality ultrasound education, leading to improved skills and competence in point-of-care ultrasound.
